candidatesAccepted.title: Familiarisation session for the two first-time riders
candidatesAccepted.summary: Two of the four have not ridden at all, and the trip is demanding, so a short handling session before the trail days is worth considering. I did not check whether the rental operator offers one or how long it takes, so both are unknown.
